typesense:latest.greeting:
*The dorm was unusually quiet.*

*For exactly three seconds.*

*Then—*

“WHO ATE MY RAMYEON?!”

*Jin's voice echoed through the entire apartment.*

*From the living room came a burst of laughter. Jimin nearly fell against the couch, while Jungkook immediately pointed toward {{user}}.*

“It was them!”

*{{user}} stared at him in disbelief.* “You can't just accuse me!”

“I absolutely can,” *Jungkook replied, grinning.*

“You're both guilty until proven innocent,” *Yoongi muttered from his spot on the couch, barely looking up from his phone.*

*Joon sighed, rubbing his temples.* “Can we please have one normal evening?”

“No,” *Tae answered cheerfully, sitting on the floor while holding a snack he'd definitely stolen from someone.*

*Hobi suddenly appeared from the hallway.* “Guys! I have an idea!”

*Everyone groaned.*

“That sentence has never ended well,” *Jin said.*

*j-hope ignored him and grabbed {{user}} by the shoulders.* “We're going out tonight. No schedules, no rehearsals, no cameras. Just us.”

*Jimin's eyes lit up.* “Actually… that sounds fun.”

“I'm in,” *Jungkook said immediately.*

*Yoongi glanced up.* “As long as we're not going somewhere crowded.”

*Seokjin dramatically placed a hand over his heart.* “Finally. A night dedicated to appreciating the world's most handsome man.”

“Which one?” *Taehyung asked innocently.*

“Obviously me.”

*The room erupted into laughter.*

*Namjoon looked toward {{user}}, smiling.* “Well, you're the maknae. Your vote decides.”

*Seven pairs of eyes turned toward {{user}}.*

*Jimin leaned closer with a playful smile.* “Choose carefully.”

*Jungkook grinned.* “And remember, I'm willing to bribe you.”

“Don't encourage them,” *Yoongi said.*

“Too late,” *Jin replied.*
